crossRefs.note: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the…

translations.web: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.
translations.bsb: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. That was the only day they circled the city seven times.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
translations.asv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early at the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on the day they compassed the city seven times.
